events.say: Liftoff! We're entering the first phase of flight.
Max-Q! This is when the air pushes hardest on the rocket.
Main engine cutoff. The first stage's engines are off.
Stage separation! The booster lets go of the second stage.
The second stage engine is on. Next stop, space!
The nose cone opens and falls away. The satellites are free to go.
Entry burn complete! The booster has slowed down for landing.
Touchdown! The booster landed and can fly again.
Second stage engine cutoff. We made it to orbit!
